credibility_note: The article calls the S$6.61 charge a "Waiting Time Fee", while the main policy page calls S$6.61 the Cancellation Fee (META-04 known conflict). Reading the condition as covering the no-show cancellation fee is an interpretation, so the norm is B. The interpretation is made once for all cases (the META-04 resolution), so applying it to a case is HARD. The radius, time tolerance, look-back window and outlier settings are FairRyde parameters (D), tested case by case by the sensitivity test.
